notes.text: A limited targeted proof check confirms the final descent step: under the usual topos definition, an epimorphic image F of a quasi-compact object G is quasi-compact. Pull back a covering family of subobjects of F to G, choose a finite subcover, and compose its epimorphic coproduct map with G→F. The resulting map factors through the corresponding finite coproduct of the original subobjects, so that finite family covers F. The live paragraph read here does use G→F in this direction. This check does not establish existence of G, its quasi-compactness as a topos object, the earlier coherence criterion, or the equality of constructibility notions.
notes.basis: Actual main-reader argument in decisions/scan025_math_work.md, connected to the finally read live paragraph. No research or transcription repair.
notes.event_outcome: Passed conditionally under the stated topos definition and pullback/epimorphism properties: finite-subcover proof of quasi-compactness descending along G→F. All earlier cited ingredients remain unchecked.

Wider local crops were necessary for the cancellation geometry and the disputed order of sloping baselines; overlaps were incidental to distinct loci, not repeat adjudication.
